beats.title: AI-Augmented Engineering
beats.text: Beyond raw chat prompting lies AI-Augmented Engineering: deterministic architecture, accelerated by autonomous coding agents.

beats.title: Deterministic PRDs & Agent Skills
beats.text: Every build begins with Deterministic PRDs — locking ERDs, OpenAPI contracts, and RBAC rules — steered by twenty-one modular Agent Skills from disciplined prompt engineering.

beats.title: Claude Code, Google Antigravity & MCP
beats.text: Claude Code and Google Antigravity execute in parallel, governed by custom TypeScript MCP servers I built — forty-three tools enforcing task DAGs, exclusive file locks, and real browser evidence gates.

beats.title: Hybrid & Agentic RAG
beats.text: Hybrid and Agentic RAG fuses Supabase pgvector semantic search with BM25 lexical reranking via Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion — achieving ninety-one point six seven percent recall, one point zero MRR, six hundred ninety-four millisecond Redis responses, and a self-critic grounding loop.

beats.title: Full-Stack Production Matrix
beats.text: Production layers span React nineteen, Next.js sixteen, Vue, Tailwind four, and Framer Motion — backed by Node, NestJS, Express, Hono, and Laravel on PostgreSQL, Prisma, Neon, Redis BullMQ, and offline Dexie — across TypeScript, Python, PHP, Kotlin, and MQL5.

beats.title: Verification & Deployment
beats.text: Verified by Jest, Supertest, and thirteen-viewport Playwright audits, then shipped via GitHub Actions to Vercel and Cloudflare Workers. Engineered to ship — verified to last.
